raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the logical comparison between the release years of the films "Circus Of Love" and "The Kiss Of Evil." While the correctly gathered data indicated that "Circus Of Love" was released in 1954 and "The Kiss Of Evil" was released in 2011, the Planner erroneously concluded that "Circus Of Love," being supposedly released "more recently in 2015," was the more recent release. This contradicts the fact that only the 1954 release date was verified. The error fits the pattern of misinterpretation of temporal comparison logic, similar to Example 1.
